user.title: Data source
user.description:
Where should GrowSolar read the solar system from?

- **DongleGrowatt** – Growatt inverter(s) with the ShineWiFi-X2 dongle flashed with the [Growatt-SPF6K-HA]({firmware_url}) firmware, one dongle per inverter, with its Home Assistant package installed. GrowSolar can also change the inverter settings this way.
- **Solar Assistant** – no dongles: the inverter(s) are connected by USB cable to Solar Assistant, and Home Assistant gets the data from Solar Assistant over MQTT.
- **Choose the sensors myself** – another inverter brand (not Growatt), or any system whose sensors are already in Home Assistant: you pick the power, battery and energy sensors in the next step.

Found now: DongleGrowatt inverters: {dongle}, Solar Assistant inverters: {sa}.
